infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Locus uses your location so you can discover and unlock family memories anchored to physical places.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Locus uses your location to notify you when you walk near a tagged family memory.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Locus uses your microphone so you can record voice stories at tagged locations.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Locus uses your camera so you can attach photos and videos to location tags.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Locus to check your proximity to family memory tags.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Locus to record audio stories for your memory tags.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Locus to attach photos to your location tags.
